title: Pause and resume physics subtree cause error : pinned_vertex >= visual_vertex_count
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.1.stable.mono.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

windows 11

### Issue description

This happened in the [gdquest-demos/godot-4-new-features](https://github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-4-new-features) project. Every time when toggling between mainmenu scene and 3d_physics_nodes scene, the debugger will add 6 error messages:
E 0:00:30:112   ui_scene_selector.gd:281 @ resume(): Condition "pinned_vertex >= visual_vertex_count" is true. Continuing.
    modules/godot_physics_3d/godot_soft_body_3d.cpp:574 @ create_from_trimesh()
  ui_scene_selector.gd:281 @ resume()
                ui_scene_selector.gd:256 @ _input()
Replacing the Node.ProcessMode with SetPhysicsProcess( ) still generates errors.
I found that this is caused by the lack of synchronization between the physics engine and rendering engine. Although it does not affect the program execution, how to fix this error.


### Steps to reproduce

1. clone the  [gdquest-demos/godot-4-new-features](https://github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-4-new-features) project.
2. Run.
3. Toggle between mainmenu and 3d_physics_nodes scene.
4. Error appears in the debugger.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

 [gdquest-demos/godot-4-new-features](https://github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-4-new-features)
